title: Steadier riders online
items: Other riders keep moving smoothly through a short network hiccup instead of freezing and then jumping ahead.
When a rider's position has to be corrected, they slide back into place instead of teleporting.
Small behind-the-scenes clean-ups to how the game passes work between its threads.

title: Smoother online races
items: Players on strict networks (school, office, some mobile data) now connect through Cloudflare's relay over the normal secure web port, so they stay on the fast WebRTC connection instead of slowing the whole race down.
A race waits a few seconds for a player who is still connecting before it starts, instead of falling back to the slower path.
Riders whose updates arrive late are drawn closer to where they really are, so someone ahead no longer looks behind.
Voice chat in races goes over the faster WebRTC connection, and racers can talk during the countdown.
A short network blip no longer drops your connection: the game waits a few seconds for it to come back.
Fixed: a player leaving right as a race started could make the race hang; a racer who left the race could no longer hear or be heard.
Reload the page so everyone in a room has this version.

title: Faster on weaker PCs
items: If your PC can't hold the frame rate you picked (above 60), the game now caps itself at a rate it holds steadily, and lifts the cap when there's room. Steady frames feel smoother than a rate that jumps around.
If the graphics card is what's slow, the resolution steps down a level in heavy scenes and goes back to your setting when things calm down.
The game starts a little sooner: the graphics code loads while the rest downloads.
In an online room, the room's track downloads first, so you can race sooner after opening the page.

title: Easier to use
items: "Controls and keys" on this page shows every key: V to talk, Y to chat, ` for the menu.
An invite link says which room you're joining; a wrong access code and a site that didn't answer are told apart.
The room list shows who is TALKING, and the race feed says who finished where, who rejoined, and who joined or left the room.
If the game stops, the menu says so and offers to reload the page. Problems with the microphone or the network show a short note over the game.
The Dev notes can be folded away with their minimize button.

title: Lower ping, and no more mystery lag
items: Rooms now run where your connection actually reaches Cloudflare, not just by country. Some internet providers send players in India to Paris or Marseille: a room in Hong Kong was 380-640 ms away for them, now it's about 200 ms.

If a race has to go through the server because someone isn't on WebRTC, the chat now says who ("Slower race: NAME not on WebRTC"). Riders lag in those races, so everyone should reload the page to get the latest version.

title: Voice chat everywhere, race feed, usernames
items: Voice chat works anywhere in a room now: the lobby, the race room, before the start and while watching. In a race, other riders still sound nearer or farther by distance; riders who finished or are watching are heard by everyone.
The race shows what happens: "NAME KNOCKED OUT NAME" when a hit throws a rider off, and "NAME DISCONNECTED" when a player leaves.
In the room's player list, HOST is shown in yellow and YOU in red.
Pick your username on this page before you play: it's the name other players see.
The Invite friends button gets out of the way once the race starts (it stays in the ` menu).

title: Invite links say whose game it is
items: A room's invite link (menu > Copy invite link, or Invite friends) now shows "Join NAME's game" with how many riders are in, when you paste it in Discord or WhatsApp.
The link works for friends who have never been here: it brings everything needed to play.

title: Smoother races on gaming laptops
items: Chrome and Edge often draw the game on a laptop's Intel graphics instead of its NVIDIA or AMD card. On our test laptop the NVIDIA card makes the busiest race moments about 65% faster (55 fps instead of 33).
The start page now tells you when the game is on Intel graphics, and how to switch: Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics > your browser > High performance, then restart the browser.

title: Online races over WebRTC
items: Browser players now race through Cloudflare's network directly: other riders show about 6x sooner than before (around 60 ms instead of 350 ms).
If WebRTC can't connect (a strict network, an old browser), the race goes through the server instead, so nobody is left out.
Riders are drawn where they are now, not where they were: smoother movement and fewer jumps.

title: Faster start, new look
items: The disc downloads the game's levels, music and riders first and the movies last: everything a race needs is in your browser after about 5 minutes on a typical line.
You can join a room right away: anything not downloaded yet streams as the game needs it.
A Windows 98 look for this page and the in-game menu (the key above Tab opens it while you play).

title: Downhill Revived 0.7.13 under the hood
items: No more slow motion when the frame rate dips: the game keeps real time.
Pickups on the track are shared in online races.
Rejoin: if your connection drops in a race, you keep your place and come back.
Voice chat (hold V), text chat (Y), and REVIVED SETTINGS with an Online tab for voice and name tags.
